title: One Health workbench
purposeSignIn: Authenticated, role-gated capture for human, animal, food and environmental AMR surveillance.
purpose: Capture and coordinate human, animal, environmental, food-chain, stewardship, IPC and genomic signals through auditable modules.

identityNotice.title: Local identity
identityNotice.body: Passwords are PBKDF2-SHA256 hashed. The active session is memory-only and expires after inactivity.

fields.usernameHint: 3–64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.

hints.draftStatus: Data-entry users save drafts for review.
hints.temporaryPassword: Minimum {{minimum}} characters — {{entered}} entered; communicate out of band.
hints.closureEvidence: Closure requires evidence; other updates may also append evidence.

modules.emptyMessage: The local module registry returned no active definitions.

sensitiveCapture.title: Sensitive capture
sensitiveCapture.body: Direct-care and regulatory events require an administrator or steward. Your role remains read-only for this module.

records.emptyMessage: Capture the first module-specific surveillance event.
records.noAccessMessage: This role can operate exchange only; it cannot view row-level events.

alerts.sectionDescription: Deterministic rule signals requiring human review.
alerts.emptyMessage: Configured rule signals will appear here for review.

actions.sectionDescription: Owned actions retain status changes and append-only closure evidence.
actions.emptyMessage: Create an action from a reviewed event or alert.

outbox.sectionDescription: Only aggregate summaries enter this sync outbox; row-level events do not.
outbox.emptyMessage: Use Enqueue aggregate to prepare an approved module summary.

audit.sectionDescription: PBKDF2 identity actions are linked by SHA-256 hashes.

modals.usersDescription: Administrators create local identities; passwords are never displayed again.
modals.createActionDescription: Link to an event when possible. The authenticated actor owns this change.

help.governanceBody: The first administrator is explicitly created on this device. AMRIT never installs or displays a default password.
help.title: One Health workbench
help.actorBody: Every governed mutation is bound to the authenticated main-process identity. Renderer fields cannot override the actor.
help.federationBody: Enqueue aggregate places only calculated summaries in the sync outbox. Named GLASS, ANIMUSE and InFARM projections are explicit local exports and are never automatically synchronized.
help.actionsBody: Stewards manage corrective actions; closure requires evidence. Reviewers resolve rule alerts. Auditors can independently verify the SHA-256 audit chain.
